title: Extremely Difficult to Cancel Subscription – Buyer Beware!
body: I would strongly caution anyone considering this app. Signing up and getting charged was easy, but trying to cancel the subscription has been an absolute nightmare. The app directs me to cancel through Apple App Store subscriptions, but ToonShort does not even appear there. I’ve searched through the app itself and cannot find a straightforward way to cancel. Meanwhile, recurring charges continue to appear on my bank statement. Customers should NOT have to jump through hoops, hunt for hidden cancellation options, or chase down customer service just to stop being charged for an app they no longer want. If you’re going to charge people for a subscription, you should make canceling just as easy as signing up. Very frustrating experience. I would not recommend this app until they make their cancellation process transparent and user-friendly.
